locations.name: MetroLux Theatres + IMAX @ San Clemente
locations.description: MetroLux Theatres + IMAX at San Clemente, at the Outlets at San Clemente, open since 2022. Standard auditoriums get in-seat food and drink delivery during the film; IMAX auditoriums specifically are counter pickup only, per the chain's own site. The theater is paired with Scripted Bar & Kitchen, a standalone full-service restaurant on the second floor that doesn't require a movie ticket to visit, which several reviewers use independently of seeing a film for lunch, dinner, or date nights. Reviews consistently praise the food and staff, including a detailed account of a private event handled exceptionally well. The most consistent complaint, raised independently by multiple reviewers, is that the bar/lobby area gets uncomfortably hot in summer, with regulars bringing their own portable fans.
